description: Sea Level Calculator is a model or estimator listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office for Coastal Management. Access location-specific scenarios for sea level and flooding and information about present-day and past conditions. Local governments and other practitioners can use the information to plan adaptation investments. The site incorporates data, maps, and visualizations and produces automated, location-specific reports. Features include:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Critical Facilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
